finalText:
Found it: `processOrder.js` grabbed a connection with `pool.acquire()` but only released it on success, no `try/finally`. Every failed order left a connection stuck as in-use. Your worker log shows that exact pattern — a run of `invalid order payload` failures right before 2:06am, then `pool exhausted: no connections available` twice, matching the page.

`handleRequest` was fine the whole time since it already used the safe `withConnection` wrapper.

Fixed by wrapping the release in `try/finally` so it happens on both success and failure. All 4 tests pass now (they'd failed before because they expected connections back after simulated failures).
